# ISS-NNN: <one line statement of the problem>

<!-- Basic boiler Plate Doc | Grade A
     Why this file exists: The shape of an issue, so a finding is recorded with enough detail to
     act on later.
     Grade A here: nothing in this file is specific to this project. Copy it unchanged.
     Grades: A copy into a new project as is, no edits. B copy it and swap the
     names, paths or patterns named above. C leave behind, it is this project's
     own content rather than scaffolding, and is not tagged.
-->

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Severity | CRITICAL \| HIGH \| MEDIUM \| LOW |
| Status | OPEN \| IN PROGRESS \| FIXED \| WONT FIX \| PARKED \| CLOSED |
| Found | YYYY-MM-DD |
| Found in | Document, module, or review |
| Affects | FEAT / ADR / TASK identifiers |

## Problem

What is wrong, and what it causes. Not what to do about it.

## Evidence

How it is known to be a problem. A failing test, a document contradiction, a
measured number, or a named precedent.

## Resolution

What was decided. FIXED here means the decision is recorded, not that code
exists. Implementation status lives only in `tasks/STATUS.md`.

## Verification

How it will be confirmed fixed once implemented. Usually the name of a test.
